findings.motion: HB 1246, Safeguarding Elections Act, co-sponsor; referred to Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
findings.note: Baker is listed as a co-sponsor, not a primary sponsor. Among many changes, the bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/HTML/H1246v1.html) would make it a Class 2 misdemeanor for any person to demand citizenship documentation from a voter other than what State law requires during the voting process. It also deals with election observers, voter challenges and absentee-ballot challenges.

findings.motion: HB 691, Voter Protection and Reliance Act, primary sponsor; referred to Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
findings.note: Baker is one of four primary sponsors. The bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/HTML/H691v1.html) says no vote may be excluded based on a law, court ruling or interpretation not in effect on election day, and sets timing rules for election lawsuits. It does not set an ID or citizenship rule. Saved as related election-integrity material.
